# Umair — Senior Mobile Developer

Umair is a Senior Mobile Application Engineer with 8+ years of experience building high-performance, cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, iOS, and Android platforms.

## About

Umair specialises in crafting exceptional mobile experiences that serve millions of users. He has delivered 50+ apps across iOS and Android with a strong focus on clean architecture, beautiful UI/UX, and seamless user experiences.

- **iOS & Android** — Native modules, platform-specific optimisations (88%)
- **State Management** — Redux, MobX, Context API, Zustand (90%)
- **UI/UX Design** — Pixel-perfect implementations, animations, gestures (85%)
- **Backend Integration** — REST APIs, GraphQL, Firebase, WebSockets (87%)
- **CI/CD & Testing** — Jest, Detox, Fastlane, GitHub Actions (82%)
- **Performance** — Profiling, optimisation, memory management (89%)
